Subject: Quick heads up — running late from conf, possible shift?

Hi Sean,

I'm presenting at a conference panel this morning that is running behind (apologies, it went into Q&A). My original interview slot at 10:30 PT is going to be tight — I expect to be able to leave the venue around 11:00 and hit downtown around 11:30 if traffic cooperates.

If possible, could we either move my start to ~11:15–11:30 or compress the loop so I can do the most critical screens first? I can also take a short recorded coding task if shoehorning the schedule is hard. Really sorry for the last-minute ask — I want to be respectful of the team's time.

Resume attached for quick reference: jamal_reed_resume.pdf (PDF).

Thanks — Jamal

Thanks for the heads-up, Jamal — appreciate the note.

Marissa / Irene: Jamal is stuck at a conference panel that is running long and estimates outbound around 11:00 PT, arriving downtown ~11:30. Options I see: 
- Move the loop start to 11:15 and compress a couple of sessions to 30m (still keep a separate hire-manager + culture slot).
- Keep start at 10:30 and have Jamal join remotely for the first screen, then come onsite for the remainder.
- Offer a short recorded coding exercise and reconvene for a follow-up 30m hire-manager call later in the day.

Proposed quick plan: move start to 11:15, condense Tech 1 (engineer screen) to 30m and combine Systems + Design into a single 45m slot. I attached a condensed agenda (condensed-agenda-v1.pdf) and created a calendar update (calendar-update.ics). If that's okay I can push invites now and notify facilities about the room change.

Jamal — is 11:15 (start) acceptable if we compress the technical screens as above? If not, tell me preference (remote-first / recorded exercise) and we'll adjust.

Thanks — Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
